title: rulingia crispa
intro: Rulingia crispa, commonly known as the "Golden Penda" or "Penda", is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the plant's bioactive compounds may help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation, making it a promising candidate for further research and potential use in traditional medicine.
